description: Call this before sending products described by their specs instead of model numbers (e.g. specs_from or a custom product), or to map your own catalog fields onto ours: returns every standard family with its reviewed values (lens mounts, battery platforms, memory types, connectors, filters), the formats for new values and the numeric limit keys. Not needed for normal checks with model numbers. Free, read-only.
name: list_standards
title: List the standards vocabulary
